validation_plan: Verify selected component IDs and installation guidance against cited official sources.
Map typography, spacing, radius, colors, surfaces, shadows, icons and motion to host tokens.
Test keyboard/focus behavior, responsive layouts and prefers-reduced-motion behavior.
Run the host project's lint, typecheck, tests and production build.
Run ui-quality-audit and resolve every fail; pending checks do not raise the verified score.

checks.note: Verify one token system for typography, spacing, radius, color, surfaces, shadows and icons.
The plan keeps role ownership bounded.
Test semantics, labels, keyboard interaction, visible focus and contrast in the host application.
Test narrow, medium and wide layouts with real content lengths.
No motion ecosystem is selected; no additional motion dependency requires verification.
No data visualization library is selected.
No unresolved Rive asset-rights blocker is declared.
Run lint, typecheck, tests, build, dependency audit and secret scan in the host project.
No paid-content or React Bits redistribution violation is declared.

audit.rule: Pending checks never raise the verified score. Fix every fail and attach evidence for rendered-host checks before release.
